final: WITH cc AS (SELECT c.country AS country, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM cc), p AS (SELECT cc.country, cc.cnt, cc.cnt * 1.0 / tot.total AS ratio FROM cc JOIN tot ON tot.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avgc FROM p WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT p.cnt, p.ratio, a.avgc FROM p JOIN a ON a.avgc IS NOT NULL WHERE p.cnt > a.avgc) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_kept_count, AVG(ratio) AS avg_kept_ratio, AVG(cnt - avgc) AS avg_kept_diff FROM k
